name: Equinox Balance
description: Equinox Balance possesses an axial tilt of nearly zero degrees, granting it perpetual equinox across its entire surface. The seasons do not change here; instead, climate zones remain fixed in perfect latitudinal bands. Symmetrical mountain ranges mirror each other across the equator with uncanny precision, as though the planet were designed on a drafting table. Twin caldera lakes sit at exactly opposing latitudes, their waters identically composed.

The atmosphere is mild and consistent, free of the violent storms that plague most habitable worlds. A gentle breeze circulates from pole to equator in predictable patterns, carrying the sweet pollen of the grassland belt that girds the planet's midsection. There is an eerie calm to Equinox Balance, a sense of mathematical perfection that unsettles visitors accustomed to chaotic weather.

Botanists have cataloged over twelve thousand species of flora, many producing compounds with potent medicinal applications. The plants here have evolved without seasonal pressure, developing instead into hyper-specialized ecological niches of extraordinary complexity. Some researchers theorize the planet's symmetry is artificial, perhaps the work of a long-vanished terraforming intelligence, though no direct evidence has been found.

Pharmaceutical corporations have established research stations along the grassland belt, extracting compounds that show promise against neural degenerative diseases. The planet's value as a botanical preserve conflicts sharply with commercial interests. A growing coalition of scientists advocates for Equinox Balance's designation as a protected biosphere, but the lure of profit continues to draw new expeditions.
